name: menu-flag-clear
summary: Clears the "quick input menu open" flag (0x453C70 bit 16) once the OSD is back in state 6; stock leaves it set when the menu is closed by a key, which blocks "No signal" and the standby countdown. v2: also ends a link-event pause (bit 13) left set outside its OSD state 0x0D, which stops all input detection

edits.asm: mf_task (image head zero area 0x202900): OSD state 6 and 0x453C70 bit 16 set -> clear bit 16; bit 13 set outside OSD state 0x0D -> sub_265EAE + restart detection; RAM 0x2024EB recoveries
main loop: jal sub_20BD37 -> jal mf_task
